title: Implement Settings, Credits and platform purchase/privacy controls
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the exact referenced imported design sections before editing. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is canonical for production mechanics: six-node Repair/Sabotage tracks, one-person crew votes, Route/Gate operations, deterministic powers and silent spectators. SCREEN-FLOW prototype 5/5 scores and hardcoded transitions are UX references only. Preserve historical T01–T10 APIs/tests; implement the new view version in new game-v1 modules instead of silently changing legacy five-mark boards or command parsers. Use black/charcoal/neutral-frost chrome and full-colour approved expressive content through semantic asset keys. Modal-first means the complete game background is uniformly blur/dim/desaturated and inert; the fixed platform banner dock remains mounted outside that game viewport. No visible accounts/login, telemetry, credentials, live Firebase, ad SDK or unreviewed asset downloads. Keep local presentation distinct from authority: clients display server/solo-engine phases and deadlines, never compute secret outcomes, choose timeout targets, advance multiplayer on a local clock or reveal another alignment. Use injected semantic media/ad/purchase ports; no direct SDK playback or billing calls from UI. Edit only ownership, use original fixtures, run scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check. DOM tests use jsdom, explicit afterEach(cleanup), Vitest and current Testing Library. Report results and contract changes; do not commit, push, open PRs, deploy or spend on providers. Implement the shared-nav Settings screen and in-game settings modal from semantic preference/purchase/consent ports. Expose separate Sound Effects/Music/Haptics, Appearance System/Dark/Light, Language System/Español/English, Reduce Motion, Privacy Policy and Credits. Credits is a blocking glass modal sourced from approved asset/audio manifests. Expose Remove Ads and Restore purchases from verified platform state; no fake sale timer, account prompt or promised cross-store/web entitlement. Controls emit semantic requests; no SDK or receipt logic. Persist selections only via the reviewed preference port and show concrete unsupported/unavailable states.
acceptance: Every specified setting has a labeled control with correct selection and System semantics; Music/SFX/Haptics remain independent.
Credits derive exact approved provenance/attribution from manifests rather than hardcoded track claims.
Remove Ads/Restore reflect pending/owned/unavailable/failed verified states without speculative entitlement or blocking gameplay.
Privacy choices and native capability failures render safely, and settings modal locks the background while Home navigation stays above the banner.
designSections: SCREEN-FLOW: Support screens; AUDIO-SPEC: User control; MONETIZATION-SPEC: Remove Ads IAP
